en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a line of horse-drawn carts and carriages with drivers and pedestrians in a town square or open street, backed by multi‑storey Mediterranean-style buildings with shutters. The scene is bustling with people and appears to depict everyday urban life. There is printed French text at the bottom identifying the view as being from Corfu and describing the vehicles used for transporting food supplies, along with a publisher line indicating Paris.
